note: Beats 5-7 (art-world, crossing, programming-world, 930-1650): the pose pass of the story points sp-5.1 to sp-7.4, each key bound to its story point. The body only, in film frames. Beat 4's keys are v3/poses/s02-the-frame.json.

keys.name: paper
keys.moment: A white page and nothing on it: she stands before the paper with her arms down while Clawd holds a crayon out.

keys.name: take
keys.moment: The right hand opens and closes on the crayon Clawd holds out: a tool is given.

keys.name: draw
keys.moment: The crayon raised, she draws the first sweep of a stalk in the air.

keys.name: draw-b
keys.moment: The second and third sweeps: the arm crosses the other way and the line stays where it was drawn.

keys.name: real
keys.moment: The lines fill and a real stalk stands there, its leaf opening: both hands come open at once.

twinned.why: both hands open at once: delight is a matched gesture, and the asymmetry is Codex's hand on the stalk

keys.name: carry
keys.moment: She lifts the stalk like a lantern and turns to the edge of the paper, where the lines begin.

keys.name: reduce
keys.moment: Everything is lines now; she walks on with the stalk held in front of her.

keys.name: reroute
keys.moment: She steps aside as Codex strides past to take the lead, the stalk held close.

keys.name: grid
keys.moment: A dark grid with lit edges: she stops, the stalk at her side, and looks where Codex points.

keys.name: join
keys.moment: The stalk goes down against the other piece: she leans in with the arm out, and holds.

keys.name: run
keys.moment: Her hands come away and she steps back to watch the chain run, arms down.

keys.name: return
keys.moment: The frame stands ahead as a window with home in it: she steps toward it, one arm out.
